title.en: Ordinance to cut the warning before a car parked illegally on private property can be booted, from 30 to 20 minutes

title.ht: Òdonans pou redui avètisman an anvan yo ka bloke yon machin ki pake ilegalman sou pwopriyete prive, de 30 a 20 minit

context.en: The ordinance covered booting on private lots, not towing itself.
context.es: La ordenanza trataba de inmovilizar autos en lotes privados, no de remolcarlos.
context.ht: Òdonans lan te sou bloke machin nan pakin prive, pa sou remòke yo.
